label: UI Mock: Agent Terminal
description: A dark agent-console mock that BUILDS on screen: the prompt types character by character with a cursor, then thinking/status/done lines stream in one at a time. Use for 'ask the agent' beats -- the moment a human hands work to an AI. Brand accent on the mode chip and status dots.

prompt.label: The prompt that gets typed (the star of the beat)

lines.label: Array of streamed lines after the prompt: {text, kind: 'thinking'|'status'|'done'} or plain strings (status)

type_at.label: Seconds before the prompt starts typing (default 1.0)
